failedPersistenceRun.failureReason: The persistence assertion expected 18 collision onsets, while the normalized analyzer reported 19 under a different collision definition.

definitions.netPitchSetCardinalityLossOnset: after unique MIDI pitch-set cardinality is smaller than before; the first-pass failure-analysis counted 18 such changed onsets
definitions.newDuplicateMidiIdentityOnset: at least one MIDI value that was not duplicated before becomes duplicated after; the normalized analyzer counted 19 such changed onsets
definitions.whyCountsMayDiffer: A changed onset can replace an existing duplicate MIDI identity with a different duplicate MIDI identity while keeping total pitch-set cardinality unchanged. Such an onset is counted by the new-duplicate-identity definition but not by the net-cardinality-loss definition.

recoveryRule: Do not rerun the failed workflow. Re-materialize the deterministic normalized analysis once under a separate recovery workflow solely because the successful output was not persisted. Use the exact existing analyzer blob and immutable preserved inputs; verify both collision definitions explicitly; persist outputs; update the original sentinel; delete both workflow files; do not alter analysis thresholds or construct a candidate.
